script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying nobody expected the woman to have a house full adds expectations the text does not give.
“Ma'am” assumes the baker's gender. Papa calls the baker “baker” or “friend.”
The explanation introduces a wedding that the passage does not describe.
“The wrong end of the story” calls the baker's selected answer wrong.
Saying nobody is throwing a party for the wife “yet” adds a detail and suggests a future party that the text does not mention.
“Noah's oath” attributes the oath to Noah. The LORD says He swore it.

“Mountains move before His covenant of peace does” makes the mountains' removal definite and can imply that the covenant will eventually move. The verse says the mountains may be removed, but the covenant will not be broken.
“Jewels are the whole building material” goes beyond the described features and overlooks the antimony mentioned in the passage.
The classroom joke uses a school scenario, which is outside the adult audience rules.
“Ends up on the ground” makes falling before the city a literal physical detail the text does not specify.
The remark about the jeweled gates and temptation suggests a motive for an attack that the passage does not give.
“It just doesn't get anywhere” goes beyond the promise that the weapon will not prosper.
Saying the weapons belong to the servants confuses weapons formed against them with their heritage.
The explanation is generic and ends by merely repeating that vindication comes from the LORD, without making the answer clearer.
